description.zh: WAF规则集的ID，可通过调用[ListWafRulesets](~~2878359~~)接口获取。
description.en: The WAF ruleset ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListWafRulesets](~~2878359~~) API.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the site. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) API.

description.zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0。
description.en: The version number of the site configuration. For a site with configuration version management enabled, this parameter specifies the version to update. The default value is 0.

description.zh: 要更改的规则集的目标状态。
description.en: The target status of the ruleset.
